tldr: Lilith in Sagittarius: the wound around belief; shamed convictions gripped harder and preached louder.
body: With Lilith in Sagittarius, beliefs that were once mocked become identity. Optimism overrides reality, risky choices follow, and the shamed conviction gets pushed onto others from any available stage, because agreement feels like the healing.
gift: Conviction, persuasive fire, and a life of real purpose when the belief serves more than the wound.
challenge: Preaching over listening, denial of inconvenient reality, hasty leaps that hurt themselves or others.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
